method: consonantal-skeleton matching over Ezek_oshb.txt. The skeleton keeps only U+05D0-U+05EA and collapses whitespace; all points, cantillation and marks are dropped. MEASURED: the extract carries U+05C3 sof-pasuq 0, U+05C0 paseq 0, U+05BE maqaf 0 times, so no claim here rests on intra-verse punctuation. Counts are of VERSES carrying the form; where occurrences differ from verses both are given. Matching is TOKEN-ANCHORED, not substring: וידעת is a proper prefix of וידעתם and וידעתן, and a prefix-substring sweep of the 2s recognition form returns 28 where the token-anchored form returns 5 (= 5 + 21 + 2, the three classes blended).

word_event_formula.gloss: 'and the word of YHWH came to me, saying' - STRICT form, אלי and לאמר adjacent; the standard oracle ONSET

word_event_vayehi_any.gloss: the ויהי word-event onset allowing an INFIXED temporal phrase between אלי and לאמר (MT 12:8 'in the morning'; MT 24:1 the ninth-year dateline). The infix must not be the perfect verb היה: the pattern is anchored on the contiguous run ויהי דבר יהוה אלי, so the seven perfect-form datelines cannot enter it. An unanchored infix between ויהי and דבר returns 47 by swallowing six of them.

relation_to_the_strategy_closed_20.what_this_means: The closed 20-verse list is NOT the output of any stated guided-motion predicate; it is 20 of the 33 verses that satisfy one. The two verses #e12 A12 adjudicated, MT 40:24 (ויולכני) and MT 46:21 (ויוציאני + ויעבירני), BOTH satisfy the predicate, which is why lanes reading the bytes kept finding them. MT 46:21 also shows the mechanism: its ויוציאני is the plene spelling of the ויוצאני the 20-list does carry at MT 37:1, 42:1 and 47:2, so a literal surface-form list drops it while a predicate keeps it. MT 40:3 (ויביא אותי) is dropped by any sweep keyed on אתי alone.

This file MEASURES and does not rule: the controlling agent decides whether the v2 class supersedes the 20-verse list for row purposes, and no row is touched here.
